meaning:
ἀνα-καλύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ni., pi. ;]
to unveil: metaphorically of removing hindrance to perception of spiritual things, 2Co.3:14 3:18.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.
